scope: selected final main attempts in phase21,phase24r,phase24r2,phase26; no smoke/failed retry duplication
reference: polyline through original Topomap world_pose XY; nearest-node truth uses all original node IDs
lateral: absolute normal component at nearest finite polyline segment; endpoint longitudinal overshoot is separate, not counted as lateral
heading: absolute yaw minus segment tangent; nearest image-pose heading error also retained
node_error: primary abs(estimated_closest-true_nearest)>1 (outside ±1); >=1 also reported as sensitivity
node_timing: last available FRESH application result held forward at72Hz; before first result unknown; observation-pose aligned check additionally reported
freshest: among all8 latest received raw samples, maximum remaining native arclength after projection of current pose; lowest index ties; no safety filter
inward: endpoint-minus-robot dot unit normal toward reference >1e-9; exact-on-reference and zero-direction cases undefined, denominators explicit
samples: all integration ticks including stopped ticks; no new inference; latest stored predictions held between arrivals; 1s validity flagged
support_limit: lower edge of first0.25m bin with primary node-error fraction>0.5; no post-hoc minimum bin count; counts and nonmonotonicity reported
classification: goal SUCCESS first; applied detour+passage strictly before termination+no goal PASSED_THEN_FAIL; other applied-detour failure DETOUR_FAIL; no applied detour+no goal NO_DETOUR_FAIL reference row
passage: sudden: saved footprint passage, H2 requires both boxes; static SLW/LC: existing last-obstacle checkpoint proxy, separately marked
handover: C0/ASTAR END matched to APPLIED; G MODE_EXIT after accepted DETOUR APPLY; rejected solves and terminal interruption are not handovers
post_pass_anchor: last actual handover at/before passage, otherwise first afterwards; missing if none; all handovers separately available
node_stall: longest constant estimated-node interval; >=5s is descriptive stagnation, not by itself localization failure
post10: signed reference arclength change at t+10s; shorter terminal follow-up retained as censored, never extrapolated
arrival: primary event-weighted final success at all actual handovers; also report run-balanced and mutually-exclusive first/last-handover cohorts
decision: applied-detour run failures: PASSED_THEN_FAIL fraction>=.5 AND outside-support handover goal rate<inside; absent comparison is not satisfied
sensitivity: >=1 node threshold; sudden-only failure fraction; first/last handover and run-balanced arrival rates
limitations: post-hoc pooled phases/scenes/method versions, correlated ticks and repeated run outcomes; association not causal policy-support guarantee
